schemes.accessToken.description: "Access token required to authenticate API requests. For the PSP risk signals endpoint, the token is seller-scoped and obtained through the Solution Provider authorization-code flow. After the seller authorizes your application, exchange the authorization code for an access token at `POST https://marketplace.walmartapis.com/v3/token`. Walmart derives the seller identity from the token, so do not include a seller identifier in the request."
